title: What massage chair delivery day actually looks like
description: A 200 to 300 pound massage chair does not arrive the way a normal package does. White glove, threshold, and curbside delivery each hand you a different amount of the unboxing and placement work. What each one actually includes before you pick a shipping option.
alt_text: Diagram of the parts inside a massage chair

title: The warranty clock buyers miss: parts vs labor
description: Parts coverage on a massage chair often runs 3 to 5 years. Labor coverage, the part that pays someone to install the free part, often runs only 1 year. The gap between those two clocks is where a "free" repair quietly stops being free.
